package.description: Free, open source Windows screenshot and screen recording tool that turns one PrtScn into six polished, ready-to-paste looks.

en-US.description: Free, open source Windows screenshot and screen recording tool that turns one PrtScn into six polished, ready-to-paste looks.
en-US.longDescription:
Press PrtScn and Matteshot instantly turns any window, region, scrolling page, or screen into six polished looks ready to paste. Select and copy only the text you need directly from a screenshot with offline OCR, annotate or redact images, and record, trim, and annotate video. Everything stays on your PC: no uploads, no account, no telemetry.
Matteshot is free and open source under MIT OR Apache-2.0.
en-US.name: Matteshot
